alt: 以受控模型服务连接代码重构、浏览器任务与物理仿真工作台的编辑插画
caption: AI 生成的编辑插画：Gemini 4 Argon 扩大全球接入，开发者通过受控模型服务处理多步骤工作；非 Google 官方界面或新闻实拍。
prompt: Create a 16:9 horizontal editorial cover illustration for the Chinese AI and technology daily briefing of 14 October 2026. Lead story: Google expanded Gemini 4 Argon to global paid API and eligible app subscriptions on October 13, giving more developers access to a model designed for long, multi-step engineering work while specialized cyber access remains controlled. Make a concrete, sophisticated editorial illustration, not a news photograph or an official product screenshot. Scene: a carefully designed developer workbench on the right, with three connected transparent application panes showing nonverbal diagrams of a large codebase refactor (interwoven branches becoming a clean modular graph), a browser workflow with traceable checkpoints, and a small physics-simulation test bench. All requests route through a visible permission gateway into a single luminous faceted model core. The core should feel like an abstract software service, not a computer chip or a humanoid. Use code-like geometric structure without actual letters or text. Emphasize structured access and useful engineering outcomes, not unrestricted access, open model weights, or magical intelligence. Art style: refined 3D editorial visualization with precision, depth and tactile materials, cyan and violet light, restrained coral and pale-gold accents, a full opaque colored atmosphere. Keep the left third calm blue-violet and uncluttered for later white title overlay, with subtle continuous environment rather than empty black. No text, numbers, brand logos, watermark, generic robot, floating binary digits or stock techno wallpaper. The final illustration is solely for the site's featured cover, not evidence of a real test.
